t: When what you are asking for looks impossible
a: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
p: Innamā amruhu idhā arāda shay'an an yaqūla lahu kun fa-yakūn.
m: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
